name: Dromaeosaur Figura Model
description:
This model is of a generic large Dromaeosaur, mainly based off *Utahraptor*. It was created for use in the Figura Minecraft mod as a custom player model. There are animations for virutally every player action in the game. 
In-game, coding contols tail side-to-side movement, which is why there's little of that in the model's animations themselves. Coding also takes care of blending animations together, so some are short and choppy with no transitions between them and the idle pose. Also, because of how Minecraft animations are programmed, the head and neck in the sneaking animations had to be offset in order to look normal in-game.
Here, the netherite armor is featured. There are variations of every armor, including turtle armor, in this model as well. Each looks slightly different and the stronger the armor, the cooler the design.

name: Amethystine Blight Drone
description:
Every hive needs Drones. The mindless bugs that follow orders and work inside the hive to provide for the Queen. While they are most accustomed to working, they can *and will* defend themselves and the Queen if necessary. They have sharp, elongated legs and pincers, mainly used for transporting meat or other objects throughout the hives.

Amethystine Blight Drones are very quick and elusive, skittering about their hives gathering lichen and other cave plants. As herbivores, Amethystine drones and their Queen are largely docile, and will normally only attack when threatened or desperate.

**Other Things to Note:**  *These drones, while they normally survive on plants, have been recorded to store and eat gems and other precious minerals.*

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer.
